Yusuf @ Bablu vs State Of U.P. And Another on 13 May, 2024
Author: Krishan Pahal

High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:85171
Court No. - 76

Case :- Criminal Misc Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. No. - 4480 of 2024
Applicant :- Yusuf @ Bablu

Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Ashok Kumar Gupta
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Krishan Pahal,J.
1.
List has been revised.

2. Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as Sri Pranshu Kumar, learned A.G.A. for the State and also perused the record.
3.

The present anticipatory bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant in F.I.R./Case Crime No. 10 of 2024, under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 313, 354 IPC and 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Nagfani, District Moradabad, with a prayer to enlarge him on anticipatory bail.
4. As per prosecution story, the marriage of the brother of the applicant Asrar Ahmad was solemnized with the informant as per Muslim rites on 25.5.2021.

Subsequent to it, the applicant and Yusuf @ Bablu vs State Of U.P. And Another on 13 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/25803010/
1 other family members are stated to have subjected her to cruelty for a demand of a car and Rs. 5 lakhs as dowry.

entities.text: Yusuf @ Bablu vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 5. Learned counsel for the applicant has stated that the applicant is maliciously being prosecuted in the present case due to ulterior motive and has the apprehension of his arrest.

There are allegations against the husband, which is stated to have been committed at Ranikhet, Almora, Uttarakhand and the allegations against the applicant is of outraging her modesty by entering into her room.

It is stated that the applicant lives separately from the husband and informant duo, who live at Uttarakhand and the applicant is the resident of Moradabad and has nothing to do with the said offence as alleged by the prosecution.
It is stated that the instant case has been foisted on the applicant out of vengeance.
6. Several other submissions have been made on behalf of the applicant to demonstrate the falsity of the allegations made against him.
The circumstances which, as per counsel, led to the false implication of the applicant have also been touched upon at length.
It is further submitted that the applicant has no criminal antecedents.
In case, the anticipatory bail application of the applicant is allowed, he will not misuse the liberty and shall cooperate with trial.

7. On the other hand, learned A.G.A. has vehemently opposed the prayer for grant of anticipatory bail on the ground that the prosecution story stands corroborated by the statement of the victim recorded u/s 164 Cr.P.C., but unable to dispute the fact that the applicant has no criminal history.

8. On due consideration to the arguments advanced by the learned counsel for the parties and in view of the law laid down by the Supreme Court in the case of "Sushila Aggarwal Vs. State (NCT of Delhi)-2020 SCC online SC 98", the applicant is entitled to be granted anticipatory bail in this case.

entities.text: Sushila Aggarwal Vs. State (NCT of Delhi)-2020 SCC online SC 98
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 9 . Without expressing any opinion upon ultimate merits of the case either ways which may adversely affect the trial of the case, the anticipatory bail application of the applicant is allowed.

entities.text: Yusuf @ Bablu vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 11. In case of breach of any of the above conditions, the court concerned shall have the liberty to cancel the bail granted to the applicant.

12. It is made clear that observations made in granting anticipatory bail to the applicant shall not in any way affect the learned trial Judge in forming his independent opinion based on the testimony of the witnesses.

Order Date :- 13.5.2024 Shalini (Justice Krishan Pahal)
